answer: A verifiable delay function builds an atlas of sequential cryptographic puzzles, imposing immense temporal computation barriers against forged identities seeking the protocol zenith. By integrating zero-knowledge proofs, a cryptographic mirror validates agent parameters without revealing sensitive data, mathematically precluding synthetic Sybil replication. We enforce cryptoeconomic security primitives via mandatory staking collateral and severe slashing penalties, proving negative expected attack utility to establish a robust Nash equilibrium.
